theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cc_tm_blowup_integrals
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (G : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen G → p ∈ G → (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∫ x, f x ∂(ENNReal.ofReal ((lams j)⁻¹ ^ n) • (μ.restrict G).map (dilation p (lams j))) = ∫ x, f x ∂(ENNReal.ofReal ((lams j)⁻¹ ^ n) • μ.map (dilation p (lams j)))) ∧ ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (ε : ℝ) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), 0 < ε → μ (ball p ε) = 0 → (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∫ x, f x ∂(ENNReal.ofReal ((lams j)⁻¹ ^ n) • μ.map (dilation p (lams j))) = 0
